title: The pursuit of happiness and order
excerpt: The nonlinearity across the felt dimensions of life eliminates agency elements such as sanity, reasoning, and planning
content:
Our self is an autonomous I-controlling enemy. Our places are random, mind-bending incubators; people around us are terror-driven strategic opportunists. Distant memories are mind parasitic, originating from mindless reference-less times. 

The nonlinearity across the felt dimensions of life eliminates agency elements such as sanity, reasoning, and planning rendering the question about a purpose meaningless. For man is more like a chess piece that is oblivious to its rank. He lacks the sense of purpose because he has none, for a piece can be sacrifisied to serve the player's plan. On the other hand, Each player has a different "style" which is manisfted by each and every action he makes. The player's act embodies the purpose.
